Dear Miss Yonge
Your letter has only reached me this morning.

February will do very well for my Fairy tale to appear, as far as I am concerned—I only wanted to know its fate, & shall be glad to have it in the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) rather than worked into one of my books.[^1]
I have directed Macmillan to send you my new book, which I hope will please you
yrs truly
[E. H.

Knatchbull-Hugessen](../persons.html#819)

[^1]: \'The Search after Happiness\' MP (February 1871), 200.
